name: TiMOTION Technology Co. Ltd.
summary: TiMOTION Technology Co. Ltd. manufactures electric linear actuator systems. The company offers lifting columns, height-adjustable desk kits, gear motors, control boxes, power supplies, and accessories. It serves businesses across multiple industries in Taiwan, China, the United States, Europe, Japan, Korea, Brazil, and Australia. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
